debugger.allows: Attach the browser debugger to tabs, intercept network traffic, and manipulate code execution.
debugger.legitimate_use: Developer tools, automated testing, or in-browser code debugging extensions.

nativeMessaging.allows: Exchange messages with native applications installed on your computer outside the browser.
nativeMessaging.legitimate_use: Hardware integration, password manager desktop app sync, or security key drivers.

proxy.allows: Configure browser proxy settings and redirect web traffic through custom intermediary servers.
proxy.legitimate_use: VPN services, privacy networks, or corporate proxy management utilities.

management.allows: Install, uninstall, enable, disable, and inspect other browser extensions and web apps.
management.legitimate_use: Extension managers, enterprise administration suites, or developer toolkits.

webRequestBlocking.allows: Block, modify, or inject data into web requests in real time before they complete.
webRequestBlocking.legitimate_use: Ad blockers, tracker blockers, or advanced web security filters.

history.allows: Read and delete your browsing history and visited web page records.
history.legitimate_use: History search tools, productivity dashboards, or privacy history clean-up utilities.

cookies.allows: Read, change, and delete website cookies, including login session identifiers.
cookies.legitimate_use: Session switchers, developer cookie inspectors, or privacy tracking controllers.

tabs.allows: Access sensitive tab details such as URLs, titles, and favicon URLs across all open tabs.
tabs.legitimate_use: Tab managers, bookmarking tools, or window organization assistants.

webRequest.allows: Observe and inspect live web traffic and HTTP headers across all websites you browse.
webRequest.legitimate_use: Traffic monitoring, developer network inspection, or web security audit tools.

clipboardRead.allows: Read all text and image data currently stored on your computer clipboard.
clipboardRead.legitimate_use: Clipboard managers, translation shortcuts, or note-taking assistants.

pageCapture.allows: Save any open web page as a complete MHTML archive file.
pageCapture.legitimate_use: Offline reading apps, research archive savers, or snapshot tools.

tabCapture.allows: Capture video and audio streams directly from active browser tabs.
tabCapture.legitimate_use: Screen recorders, presentation streaming tools, or audio transcribers.

desktopCapture.allows: Capture content from your entire desktop screen, windows, or applications.
desktopCapture.legitimate_use: Video conferencing screen sharing, full-desktop recorders, or broadcast streaming tools.

privacy.allows: Control browser privacy settings such as autofill, third-party cookies, and webRTC IP leaks.
privacy.legitimate_use: Privacy hardening suites and security compliance assistants.

declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess.allows: Block or redirect network requests on specific websites based on rules matching host access.
declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess.legitimate_use: Targeted site filtering, developer mock servers, or site-specific blockers.

identity.email.allows: Read the primary email address of your signed-in browser profile.
identity.email.legitimate_use: Seamless sign-in and user identity synchronization for account-backed extensions.

webAuthenticationProxy.allows: Intercept and proxy WebAuthn hardware token authentication requests.
webAuthenticationProxy.legitimate_use: Enterprise identity bridges or passkey credential synchronization managers.

bookmarks.allows: Read, create, edit, and organize all browser bookmarks and bookmark folders.
bookmarks.legitimate_use: Bookmark managers, reading lists, or cross-browser bookmark sync tools.

downloads.allows: Initiate, monitor, pause, resume, and cancel browser file downloads.
downloads.legitimate_use: Download managers, image batch downloaders, or file routing utilities.

downloads.open.allows: Open downloaded files directly on your computer through their default system applications.
downloads.open.legitimate_use: Automated workflow tools or instant document viewer integrations.

geolocation.allows: Query your physical geographic location coordinates via browser sensors.
geolocation.legitimate_use: Local weather displays, store locator assistants, or region-specific tools.

contentSettings.allows: Control website permissions for cookies, JavaScript, camera, microphone, and popups.
contentSettings.legitimate_use: Site permission toggles, script blockers, or privacy permission profiles.

topSites.allows: Read your most frequently visited website shortcuts from the browser new-tab page.
topSites.legitimate_use: Custom new tab replacements or speed-dial dashboard organizers.

sessions.allows: Query and restore recently closed browser tabs and windows.
sessions.legitimate_use: Session restore assistants, tab recovery managers, or window snapshot utilities.

scripting.allows: Execute JavaScript and inject CSS into web pages where the extension has host access.
scripting.legitimate_use: Web page annotators, user style engines, or form autofill assistants.

webNavigation.allows: Observe detailed navigation events, redirects, and frame loading states in real time.
webNavigation.legitimate_use: Page load timers, analytics monitors, or automatic navigation helpers.

identity.allows: Obtain OAuth2 authentication tokens using browser-mediated sign-in flows.
identity.legitimate_use: Third-party service authorization for calendar, cloud storage, or social media.

browsingData.allows: Clear browser cache, cookies, download history, and autofill forms.
browsingData.legitimate_use: Privacy cleanup tools, cache clearers, or automated browsing data purgers.

declarativeNetRequestFeedback.allows: Read internal diagnostic information about blocked or modified network requests.
declarativeNetRequestFeedback.legitimate_use: Rule testing, ad blocker debugging, or network filter diagnostic suites.

printing.allows: Send print jobs directly to printers installed on the local system.
printing.legitimate_use: Receipt printers, invoice generators, or automated document printing workflows.

printerProvider.allows: Expose virtual print destinations to the browser print dialog.
printerProvider.legitimate_use: Cloud print integrations, PDF transform providers, or fax gateways.

notifications.allows: Display desktop notifications through the operating system notification center.
notifications.legitimate_use: Alerting users to incoming messages, calendar reminders, or background task completion.

offscreen.allows: Create hidden DOM documents in the background to access audio playback, clipboard, or DOM APIs.
offscreen.legitimate_use: Background audio playback, clipboard parsing, or canvas rendering in Manifest V3.

declarativeNetRequest.allows: Block or modify network requests declaratively using pre-compiled rules without seeing request content.
declarativeNetRequest.legitimate_use: Ad blocking and content filtering without access to sensitive request bodies.

declarativeContent.allows: Take page actions automatically when web pages match specific conditions without running background scripts.
declarativeContent.legitimate_use: Enabling extension popup buttons only when visiting supported websites.

search.allows: Query the browser default search engine and display results.
search.legitimate_use: Omnibox search shortcuts, quick lookups, or smart search enhancements.

gcm.allows: Send and receive push messages through Google Cloud Messaging.
gcm.legitimate_use: Receiving real-time updates and notifications from cloud web services.

favicon.allows: Request and display website favicon icons for bookmarked or open pages.
favicon.legitimate_use: Visual tab switchers, bookmark managers, or speed-dial menus.

system.cpu.allows: Query system CPU processor architecture, model name, and core usage metadata.
system.cpu.legitimate_use: System resource monitors or hardware diagnostic extensions.

system.memory.allows: Query system physical memory capacity and available RAM.
system.memory.legitimate_use: Performance monitoring dashboards or memory saver extensions.

system.storage.allows: Query attached storage devices, capacities, and monitor device attachment events.
system.storage.legitimate_use: External disk file routers or system diagnostic monitors.

system.display.allows: Query connected monitor resolutions, work areas, and display arrangements.
system.display.legitimate_use: Multi-monitor window organizers or layout placement assistants.

ttsEngine.allows: Implement a custom text-to-speech voice synthesizer engine for the browser.
ttsEngine.legitimate_use: Custom synthetic voice packages or accessibility speech tools.

background.allows: Start browser processes early at system boot and keep running after windows close.
background.legitimate_use: Background message syncing, notification listeners, or instant startup.

loginState.allows: Read the login status of the managed ChromeOS profile.
loginState.legitimate_use: Kiosk and enterprise device state verification on ChromeOS.

readingList.allows: Read, add, update, and remove items in the browser reading list.
readingList.legitimate_use: Read-it-later utilities or article collection organizers.

tabGroups.allows: Create, modify, label, color, and organize tab groups in the browser window.
tabGroups.legitimate_use: Tab grouping assistants, workflow categorizers, or project tab organizers.

clipboardWrite.allows: Write text and image data to your computer clipboard.
clipboardWrite.legitimate_use: Copying links, formatted snippets, or generated passwords with one click.

storage.allows: Store extension settings and cached data locally in the browser profile.
storage.legitimate_use: Persisting user preferences, local cache, or extension state across restarts.

unlimitedStorage.allows: Exceed standard 5 MB storage quota for extension databases and local storage.
unlimitedStorage.legitimate_use: Offline data stores, large local caches, or document drafts.

alarms.allows: Schedule code to run periodically or at specific future times in the background.
alarms.legitimate_use: Periodic feed polling, reminder triggers, or cache cleanup tasks.

activeTab.allows: Temporarily access the current active web page only when the user explicitly clicks the extension icon.
activeTab.legitimate_use: User-triggered page actions, full-page screenshots, or one-click clip tools.

contextMenus.allows: Add custom action items to the browser right-click context menu.
contextMenus.legitimate_use: Quick actions for selected text, images, or links via the right-click menu.

idle.allows: Detect when the user is idle, locked, or active on the machine.
idle.legitimate_use: Scheduling resource-heavy maintenance tasks when the user is away.

sidePanel.allows: Render custom user interface in the browser side panel companion window.
sidePanel.legitimate_use: Notes, companion dashboards, translators, or document assistants.

fontSettings.allows: Inspect and customize default browser font sizes and font families.
fontSettings.legitimate_use: Typography customizers or accessibility font enhancers.

power.allows: Prevent the computer screen or system from sleeping while a task runs.
power.legitimate_use: Presentation view, long video playback, or active kiosk displays.

tts.allows: Speak text using the browser built-in speech synthesis synthesizer.
tts.legitimate_use: Screen reading, audio alerts, or pronunciation guides.

all_sites.allows: Read and change all data on every website you visit.
all_sites.legitimate_use: Ad blockers, comprehensive password managers, or web-wide dark mode enhancers.

file_access.allows: Access and read local files stored directly on your computer filesystem.
file_access.legitimate_use: Local file viewers, Markdown previewers, or local developer utilities.

suffix_wide.allows: Access all websites under an entire top-level domain or public suffix (such as all .com or .co.uk sites).
suffix_wide.legitimate_use: Broad country-level utilities or multi-site integrations across an entire domain registry.

all_hosts_partial_path.allows: Access specific web page paths across every website on the Internet.
all_hosts_partial_path.legitimate_use: Injecting scripts on standard paths across multiple web applications.

domain_wide.allows: Access a specific domain and all of its subdomains.
domain_wide.legitimate_use: Enhancing a single web platform that operates across multiple subdomains.

single_host.allows: Access one specific website hostname only.
single_host.legitimate_use: Site-specific enhancements, styling, or workflow integration for a single site.
